title: Agent Impact Analysis Result
description: Contract for the JSON returned by POST /agent/analyse (S3-02) and rendered by the Impact Agent page's 3 output sections (S3-05). Defined jointly by An (BE) and Huyen (FE) on Sprint 3 day 1 so both can build in parallel against this exact shape without further coordination.

req_id.description: Required. The requirement code this analysis was run for, e.g. matches requirements.req_id.

version.description: Required. The requirement version (requirements.version) this analysis was run against.

summary.description: Required. Powers the FE header line: "Analysed X linked TCs + Y related TCs · Z defects".

linked_tc_count.description: Required. Count of tc_linked (test cases whose requirement_id points at this requirement version).

related_tc_count.description: Required. Count of tc_related considered (semantic top-10 cap from S3-01).

tc_updates.description: Required, may be empty. FE Section 1 "TC cần cập nhật" — existing test cases that likely need editing because of this requirement change.

testcase_id.description: Required. Powers the FE's "Open TC" button, which navigates to /testcases/:id.

code.description: Required. Test case code shown on the card.

title.description: Required. Test case title shown on the card.

reason.description: Required. Why this TC needs updating.
examples: Requirement now requires OTP to expire after 60s, but this TC's expected result assumes no expiry.

diff.description: Required. Suggested before/after wording, rendered red (before) / green (after) by the FE.

examples: OTP remains valid until manually resent.

source.description: Required, may be empty. Free-text tags citing which context fed this suggestion; rendered as a source tag badge on the card.

tc_gaps.description: Required, may be empty. FE Section 2 "TC cần thêm mới" — suggested new test cases not yet covered.

suggested_title.description: Required. Prefills the "Create TC" flow's title.

suggested_scope.description: Required. What the new TC should cover.
examples: Verify login fails when OTP is submitted after the 60s expiry window.

source.description: Required, may be empty. Each entry cites a related item plus its semantic match strength — rendered as "source tag kèm % match" on the card.

ref.description: Required. Code of the cited item.

questions.description: Required, may be empty. FE Section 3 "Câu hỏi cần xác nhận" — open questions for a human to confirm.

question.description: Required. Rendered bold on the card.
examples: Does the 60s OTP expiry apply to the password-reset flow too, or only login?
If it also applies to password-reset, TC-140 and TC-141 need the same update.
